title: The War of Measures — the eastern border country
caption: A surveyor's chart of the ground the measure-wars are fought over: the Ferr valley and the lower Ilm from Nine Pots and Stonemouth to Greybank and the Sallow shore. Burned kilns, a poisoned well, collectors' boats on the Ilm and a district left cold for a season. The cold is drawn as the thing that advances. Surveyed and inked in Y.H. 814.
